logo.description: Footer brand artwork. Shared dark-mode flattening displays it in white; its source and light-mode appearance are preserved.

themeColors.description: Authored color overrides merged over the selected colorTheme (current by default). linkAccent overrides link colors; other keys override section background colors.

darkModePolicy.description: Controls the shared dark palette. Omitted or true enables flattening; false preserves authored colors. The CLI --no-dark-mode-flatten flag always disables it. Enabled flattening switches painted HTML surfaces with their text, including intro panels, quotations, badges and authored wrappers. Authored gradients become solid dark surfaces; photographic background images remain unchanged. Inline text, WebKit text fill and background-color priorities are released. Canonical builds reject resolved dark text contrast below 4.5:1 and report image-backed text requiring visual review. Footer brand artwork and social icons display in white; editorial image assets and light-mode values remain intact.

flatten.description: Enable the renderer dark palette. False omits its dark CSS; email clients may still apply their own color conversion.

webPublicationStatus.description: Controls whether the built issue may be exposed on the public newsletter site.

logoPosition.description: Logo anchor and proportional movement within the padded social-card area. Omitted controls keep the upper-left anchor.

side.description: Upper-edge horizontal anchor before nudges are applied.

nudge.description: Movement relative to the available padded travel area. Combine x/east/west and y/north/south, then clamp each resulting axis to -1..1.

x.description: Positive moves right; negative moves left.

y.description: Positive moves up; negative moves down.

south.description: Adds downward movement; 1 reaches the lower padded edge.

footer.description: Optional social-card footer text, separate from the email footer. HTML is converted to plain text. Omitted, empty, or null values hide the footer. An explicitly supplied footer takes precedence over footerCopy.

footerCopy.description: Compatibility name for socialCard.footer. Existing sources remain supported; an explicitly supplied footer takes precedence, including empty or null values.

footerFont.description: Font registry key for social-card footer copy. Omitted, empty, or null values inherit the resolved subtitle font.

footerFontScale.description: Multiplier for the preset footer font size. Applies when footer text is present, authored through footer or footerCopy.

duration.description: Timeline duration in milliseconds, or source to preserve native timing for source/asset animation.

formats.description: Animated social-card export formats supported by the shared exporter.

speculativeJobSurfaceStyles.description: Optional surface styles for a speculative job section or card. Section-level containerStyles applies the background to the separate heading and jobs area, with a visible gap between them. Its border and borderRadius enclose the jobs area only; item-level cardStyles controls an optional inner job surface.

backgroundColor.description: Surface background color. On section-level containerStyles, the same value is applied to the section heading and jobs area. On item-level cardStyles, it applies to the inner job card.

sourceImage.description: A hosted source image, optionally with caption, accessibility text, and a destination.
